title: Editor completion — export, recovery, MCP and verification
objective: Preserve and deliver the earlier full-editor commitments after the four core milestones: safe JPEG export, metadata/color, manual Locate, MCP and complete editor verification.
context_summary: Follows the completed M4 crop editor: safe JPEG export, metadata/color proof, manual Locate, an MCP adapter and complete editor verification. Native Windows/Linux desktop work remains deferred.

acceptance_criteria: Use the history/transform/module/crop editor as the named baseline and preserve quality 90, sRGB output and Keep metadata off defaults.
Select and pin a supported ICC conversion and metadata read/write path; enumerate retained descriptive/capture/GPS fields and structural fields that must be regenerated or removed.
Choose measurable color/geometry tolerances and independent validation fixtures before implementing export.
Document supported tagged/untagged JPEG behavior and explicit errors without claiming universal ICC/private-tag or HDR support.

steps: Probe tagged/untagged/greyscale/unsupported inputs and representative metadata containers.
Independently inspect output profiles, orientation, dimensions and optional fields in reference experiments.
expected_results: Document supported tagged/untagged JPEG behavior and explicit errors without claiming universal ICC/private-tag or HDR support.

acceptance_criteria: Capture the committed stack, revision and metadata option; evaluate through shared processing and encode a new sRGB JPEG at quality 90 by default.
Strip optional metadata by default; Keep metadata retains the documented valid fields, fixes geometry/profile and removes stale thumbnails.
Reject existing destinations and every source alias; publish via a flushed temporary file without clobbering and clean it on failure/cancellation.
Native destination controls and API jobs share behavior, frozen options, progress/errors/cancellation; source hashes and prior files remain unchanged.

steps: Test symlinks/hardlinks, destination races, interrupted/cancelled writes and newer edits during export.
Inspect both metadata modes with an independent reader/viewer and compare decoded output within established tolerances.
expected_results: Native destination controls and API jobs share behavior, frozen options, progress/errors/cancellation; source hashes and prior files remain unchanged.

acceptance_criteria: Retain source-missing state, asset/layer/entry IDs and immutable history while verifying a user-selected candidate with bounded cancellable hashing.
Reject changed content and files modified during verification; allow explicit matching copies without silently merging different catalog assets.
Atomically change only the locator/source revision and notify clients; failures preserve the previous record and edit history.
UI and live API recover a moved/renamed fixture and an explicitly chosen external-volume fixture copy, with unchanged original bytes.

steps: Test renamed original, same-name mismatch, byte-identical copy, alias/duplicate asset, unavailable volume and failed persistence.
Restore and render old history entries after relinking; record native external-volume evidence separately.
expected_results: UI and live API recover a moved/renamed fixture and an explicitly chosen external-volume fixture copy, with unchanged original bytes.
